title: Works With Cotton Rounds
text: Works With Cotton Rounds. I was intrigued with this automatic cotton pad dispenser when I first saw it. I have been keeping my cotton rounds in an acrylic tube like container, but I often will pull half of a cotton round instead of the full one. I wasn't entirely positive that this would work with the round shape, but it does! The first time or two that I pressed the button to get a cotton round, it gave me two instead of one. But after that, it dispenses only one at a time. It's very sanitary. It's also a little fun to use!
